speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् ।
पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥
iast:
anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham |
pitṝṇāmaryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham ||
english: Among the nagas I am Ananta; among the beings of the waters, Varuna; among the ancestors, Aryaman; and among those who keep order, Yama.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् ।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥
iast:
prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham |
mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro'haṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām ||
english: Among the daityas I am Prahlada; among those who count, I am time; among beasts, the lion; and among birds, Garuda, son of Vinata.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् ।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ॥
iast:
pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham |
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī ||
english: Among purifiers I am the wind; among those who bear weapons, Rama; among sea creatures, the makara; and among rivers, the Ganga.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन ।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम् ॥
iast:
sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna |
adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham ||
english: Of creations I am the beginning, the end and the middle, Arjuna; of sciences, the knowledge of the self; and of those who debate, I am reasoned argument.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च ।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥
iast:
akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca |
ahamevākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ ||
english: Among letters I am the letter A; among compounds, the pairing compound. I alone am unending time; I am the creator, facing in all directions.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा ॥
iast:
mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām |
kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā ||
english: I am all-devouring death, and the origin of all that is yet to be; among the feminine, I am fame, fortune, speech, memory, intelligence, steadfastness and forbearance.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् ।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥
iast:
bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham |
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'hamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ ||
english: Among the Sama chants I am the Brihat Saman; among metres, the Gayatri; among months I am Margashirsha; and among seasons, flower-bearing spring.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥
iast:
dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham |
jayo'smi vyavasāyo'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham ||
english: Of cheats I am gambling; I am the brilliance of the brilliant. I am victory, I am resolve, and I am the goodness of the good.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः ॥
iast:
vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ |
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ ||
english: Among the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva; among the Pandavas, Arjuna; among sages I am Vyasa; and among poets, the poet Ushanas.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥
iast:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām |
maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham ||
english: Of those who restrain, I am the rod of punishment; of those who seek victory, I am statecraft; of secrets I am silence; and of the wise I am wisdom.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन ।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥
iast:
yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna |
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram ||
english: And whatever is the seed of all beings, that am I, Arjuna; nothing, moving or unmoving, could exist without me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप ।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥
iast:
nānto'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ parantapa |
eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā ||
english: There is no end to my divine glories, scorcher of enemies; what I have said is only a brief indication of their extent.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा ।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम् ॥
iast:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā |
tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃ'śasaṃbhavam ||
english: Whatever is glorious, prosperous or powerful, know that it springs from a spark of my splendour.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥
iast:
athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna |
viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat ||
english: But what use is all this detailed knowledge to you, Arjuna? I stand supporting this entire world with a single fraction of myself.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् ।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम ॥
iast:
madanugrahāya paramaṃ guhyamadhyātmasaṃjñitam |
yattvayoktaṃ vacastena moho'yaṃ vigato mama ||
english: Out of kindness to me, you have spoken the supreme secret about the self, and by those words this confusion of mine is gone.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया ।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् ॥
iast:
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā |
tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa māhātmyamapi cāvyayam ||
english: I have heard from you in detail of the origin and dissolution of beings, lotus-eyed one, and of your imperishable greatness.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर ।
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम ॥
iast:
evametadyathāttha tvamātmānaṃ parameśvara |
draṣṭumicchāmi te rūpamaiśvaraṃ puruṣottama ||
english: It is just as you have described yourself, supreme Lord. Yet I long to see your divine form, supreme Person.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो ।
योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho |
yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayātmānamavyayam ||
english: If you think it is possible for me to see it, Lord, master of yoga, then show me your imperishable self.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च ॥
iast:
paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
nānāvidhāni divyāni nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca ||
english: Behold my forms, son of Pritha, by the hundreds and the thousands, of many kinds, divine, of many colours and shapes.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा ।
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत ॥
iast:
paśyādityānvasūnrudrānaśvinau marutastathā |
bahūnyadṛṣṭapūrvāṇi paśyāścaryāṇi bhārata ||
english: See the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Ashvins and the Maruts; see many wonders never seen before, Arjuna.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् ।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि ॥
iast:
ihaikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ paśyādya sacarācaram |
mama dehe guḍākeśa yaccānyad draṣṭumicchasi ||
english: See here today the whole universe, moving and unmoving, gathered in one place in my body, Arjuna, and whatever else you wish to see.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा ।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ॥
iast:
na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā |
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram ||
english: But you cannot see me with these eyes of yours. I give you divine sight: see my sovereign power.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः ।
दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम् ॥
iast:
evamuktvā tato rājanmahāyogeśvaro hariḥ |
darśayāmāsa pārthāya paramaṃ rūpamaiśvaram ||
english: Having said this, O king, Krishna, the great lord of yoga, then showed the son of Pritha his supreme, sovereign form,

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् ।
अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् ॥
iast:
anekavaktranayanamanekādbhutadarśanam |
anekadivyābharaṇaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham ||
english: with many mouths and eyes, many wondrous sights, many divine ornaments and many divine weapons raised,

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् ।
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम् ॥
iast:
divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam |
sarvāścaryamayaṃ devamanantaṃ viśvatomukham ||
english: wearing divine garlands and garments, anointed with divine fragrances, made of every wonder, radiant, infinite, facing in every direction.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता ।
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः ॥
iast:
divi sūryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthitā |
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ ||
english: If the light of a thousand suns were to blaze forth all at once in the sky, that might resemble the splendour of that great being.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा ।
अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा ॥
iast:
tatraikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktamanekadhā |
apaśyaddevadevasya śarīre pāṇḍavastadā ||
english: There, in the body of the god of gods, the son of Pandu then saw the whole universe gathered in one place, divided in many ways.

speaker: Sanjaya
devanagari:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनंजयः ।
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत ॥
iast:
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā dhanaṃjayaḥ |
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata ||
english: Then Arjuna, overcome with wonder, his hair standing on end, bowed his head to the god and, with joined palms, spoke.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे ।
सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसंघान् ।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ- ।
मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान् ॥
iast:
paśyāmi devāṃstava deva dehe |
sarvāṃstathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṃghān |
brahmāṇamīśaṃ kamalāsanastha- |
mṛṣīṃśca sarvānuragāṃśca divyān ||
english: In your body, O God, I see all the gods and all the hosts of different beings; Brahma the lord, seated on the lotus, all the sages and the divine serpents.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं ।
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् ।
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं ।
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप ॥
iast:
anekabāhūdaravaktranetraṃ |
paśyāmi tvāṃ sarvato'nantarūpam |
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ |
paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa ||
english: I see you with countless arms, bellies, mouths and eyes, infinite in form on every side; I see no end, no middle and no beginning of you, lord of the universe, whose form is the universe.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च ।
तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ता- ।
द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम् ॥
iast:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca |
tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam |
paśyāmi tvāṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ samantā- |
ddīptānalārkadyutimaprameyam ||
english: I see you wearing a crown, bearing a mace and a discus, a mass of radiance shining everywhere, hard to look at, blazing all around like burning fire and the sun, immeasurable.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं ।
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् ।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता ।
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे ॥
iast:
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ |
tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam |
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā |
sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me ||
english: You are the Imperishable, the supreme one to be known; you are the ultimate resting place of this universe; you are the undying guardian of eternal dharma; you are, I believe, the eternal Person.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य- ।
मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं ।
स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम् ॥
iast:
anādimadhyāntamanantavīrya- |
manantabāhuṃ śaśisūryanetram |
paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ |
svatejasā viśvamidaṃ tapantam ||
english: I see you without beginning, middle or end, of infinite power, with countless arms, the sun and moon as your eyes, your mouth a blazing fire, scorching this universe with your own radiance.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि ।
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः ।
दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं ।
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन् ॥
iast:
dyāvāpṛthivyoridamantaraṃ hi |
vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaśca sarvāḥ |
dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpamugraṃ tavedaṃ |
lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman ||
english: The space between heaven and earth, and all the directions, are filled by you alone. Seeing this wondrous, terrible form of yours, great one, the three worlds tremble.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसंघा विशन्ति ।
केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति ।
स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसंघाः ।
स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः ॥
iast:
amī hi tvāṃ surasaṃghā viśanti |
kecidbhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti |
svastītyuktvā maharṣisiddhasaṃghāḥ |
stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ ||
english: These hosts of gods enter into you; some, afraid, praise you with joined palms; crying "May all be well!", hosts of great sages and perfected beings praise you with rich hymns.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या ।
विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च ।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसंघा ।
वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे ॥
iast:
rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā |
viśve'śvinau marutaścoṣmapāśca |
gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṃghā |
vīkṣante tvāṃ vismitāścaiva sarve ||
english: The Rudras, Adityas, Vasus and Sadhyas, the Vishvedevas, the two Ashvins, the Maruts and the ancestors, hosts of gandharvas, yakshas, asuras and perfected beings all gaze at you in amazement.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं ।
महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् ।
बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं ।
दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम् ॥
iast:
rūpaṃ mahatte bahuvaktranetraṃ |
mahābāho bahubāhūrupādam |
bahūdaraṃ bahudaṃṣṭrākarālaṃ |
dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitāstathāham ||
english: Seeing your mighty form, with many mouths and eyes, mighty-armed one, with many arms, thighs and feet, many bellies, and terrible with many tusks, the worlds are shaken, and so am I.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं ।
व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् ।
दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा ।
धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो ॥
iast:
nabhaḥspṛśaṃ dīptamanekavarṇaṃ |
vyāttānanaṃ dīptaviśālanetram |
dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntarātmā |
dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo ||
english: Seeing you touching the sky, blazing, many-coloured, mouths gaping and huge eyes burning, my inner self is shaken, and I find no steadiness or peace, Vishnu.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि ।
दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि ।
दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म ।
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास ॥
iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni |
dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasannibhāni |
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma |
prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa ||
english: Seeing your mouths, terrible with tusks and blazing like the fire at the end of time, I lose all sense of direction and find no comfort. Be gracious, lord of gods, refuge of the world.

speaker: Arjuna
devanagari:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः ।
सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसंघैः ।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ ।
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः ॥
iast:
amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ |
sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṃghaiḥ |
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūtaputrastathāsau |
sahāsmadīyairapi yodhamukhyaiḥ ||
english: And all these sons of Dhritarashtra, together with the hosts of kings, Bhishma, Drona, and Karna too, son of the charioteer, along with the chief warriors on our own side,
